summary.text: Michael Morgan, a Republican from West Milton, has represented Grand Isle-Chittenden in the Vermont House of Representatives since 2021.
He sits on the House Committee on Government Operations and Military Affairs and the House Ethics Panel.

paragraphs.text: Morgan was born in Burlington and has lived in Milton for all of his life except nine years of active-duty Air Force service, according to his House biography.
He graduated from Milton High School in 1979 and from the United States Air Force Academy in 1983 with a Bachelor of Science in biology.
He served in the U.S. military for 38 years and retired from the Vermont Air National Guard in 2017 at the rank of Colonel, his last major assignment being Vice Commander of the 158th Fighter Wing.
He is a former business owner.
He served on the Milton Selectboard from 1989 to 1998 and again from 2018, and has been Milton Town Moderator since 2005.
He is married to Lori and has four children.
